text:
In the last crypto cycle, people were bearish on options vs. perps because perps are “easier to understand than options and we need to onboard the masses.”  

That was such a bad take because:   

1. Massive amounts of retail traders learned options during the GME COVID era just fine.  

2. Just because it’s “easy to understand” doesn’t mean it’s good for retail traders. Futures are easier to understand than options, yet I’d sooner recommend a friend a long call option than a futures contract because futures will wipe them out if they are wrong.  

3. People in crypto like memecoins and the asymmetric upside they provide. Options (especially long calls) are the traditional market equivalent, not perps.   

4. Crypto is obsessed with composability, and options are the most composable financial product that enables you to express any opinion about the market.   

It’s great to see the leader in onchain options finally getting the attention they deserve: @DeriveXYZ

author: youyou5202
quoted_text:
你这个类比只说对了一半。

TapeOut 确实没有凭空创造新的物理算力，底层最终还是 BSC 节点的 CPU 在执行，这一点没人需要回避。

但问题是：一个协议有没有价值，并不取决于它有没有发明新的晶体管。

以太坊也没有创造新的 CPU，Uniswap 也没有创造新的美元，GitHub 也没有创造新的代码执行能力。它们创造的是新的组织方式、产权关系、验证方式和协作机制。

TapeOut 真正做的，也不是“用 NAND 替代现实 CPU”。

它做的是把数字电路设计变成一种：

可公开验证、可确权、可组合、可交易、可竞争优化的链上对象。

所以拿 Minecraft 红石电脑来类比没问题，但更完整的类比应该是：

Minecraft 红石 + GitHub + 专利/产权登记 + 电路设计竞赛 + 自动奖励市场。

重点根本不在于“这台虚拟 CPU 跑 Linux 有没有现实 CPU 快”。

当然没有，甚至慢几个数量级。

重点是以前一个电路设计只是某个人电脑里的网表文件，现在可以被链上永久记录、验证是谁设计的、谁拥有、别人能不能继续调用和组合，并且协议还能自动奖励更优设计。

这才是它真正实验的东西。

你说“NAND 为什么有价值？因为能挖 BEM，BEM 为什么有价值？因为会涨”，这个质疑其实成立，但只能证明：

当前经济需求可能高度依赖挖矿激励。

它并不能证明整个协议本身毫无意义。

真正应该观察的是：

未来有没有人“不为了挖 BEM”，仍然愿意购买、调用或者组合这些 Circuit。

如果永远没有，那你说它是反身性闭环，我完全同意。

但如果未来出现：
Circuit 被其他协议调用、
优秀设计持续产生手续费、
第三方开发者直接购买电路 IP、
电路成为链上游戏/计算协议的标准组件，

那它就从“币价驱动的游戏”变成了“有外部需求的电路市场”。

所以现在最准确的批评不是：

“这就是红石电脑，所以毫无意义。”

而应该是：

“它证明了链上电路资产和设计竞赛可以成立，但还没有证明这种资产存在足够大的外部真实需求。”

前者是在否定技术实验本身，后者才是真正打到它估值逻辑的要害。

至于 Linux，本来就是 Demo。

拿一个 Demo 去要求它必须比现实服务器便宜，本身就搞错了展示目的。

飞机第一次试飞也不是为了证明它比火车便宜，而是先证明“这个系统能跑起来”。

TapeOut 现在证明的是：

电路设计可以被协议化、资产化和链上竞争。

至于它最终是不是大产业，这才是未来真正要验证的事情。

NVIDIA-BACKED NSCALE FILES FOR NYSE IPO UNDER $NSCL; REVEALS $103.4B OF CONTRACT VALUE

Here’s everything you need to know:

Nscale is a UK-based AI cloud company headquartered in London. It builds and operates data centers, GPU infrastructure and cloud software that customers use to train AI models and run them in production.

Its filing reports $103.4B in total contract value as of Aug. 31, up from $38B at the end of 2025. These are multi-year contract amounts, not annual revenue or cash already collected.

ANTHROPIC: UP TO $44.6B

Agreements signed Aug. 25 cover Nvidia Vera Rubin computing systems at Nscale’s planned West Virginia campus.

The key financing disclosure: Nscale says it does not yet have binding commitments for the financing needed to deliver the Anthropic buildout.

The filed agreement also includes a right to terminate if the required financing is not secured by an agreed deadline.

MICROSOFT: UP TO $43.8B THROUGH 2033

Microsoft is Nscale’s other major customer. Its previously announced deployment program includes roughly 200,000 Nvidia GB300 GPUs across the U.S., UK, Portugal and Norway, with Dell participating in the infrastructure rollout.

The disclosed Microsoft and Anthropic contract amounts together reach $88.4B, equivalent to roughly 85% of Nscale’s total contract value.

How much capacity is actually running?

Nscale had approximately 461,000 GPUs active or contracted at the end of August, but only about 25,000 were operating.

That distinction matters: the contracted footprint is substantially larger than the infrastructure already delivering services.

First-half 2026 financials

• Revenue: $140.6M, up from $10.4M a year earlier
• Operating loss: $492M
• Net loss: $1.02B, including $457M in fair-value losses

Nvidia backing and fresh financing

Nvidia agreed to invest $1B as part of a $3.1B convertible financing signed Sept. 15.

Earlier this year, Nscale raised $2B at a $14.6B valuation, with backers including Nvidia, Dell, Nokia, Citadel, Jane Street and Point72. That was its March funding valuation, not an announced IPO valuation.

The offering

Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan and Morgan Stanley are leading the proposed NYSE listing. The share count and price range have not yet been determined.

The filing puts the opportunity and the execution challenge side by side: substantial customer commitments, but much of the capacity still needs to be financed, built and brought online.

text:
There's a new kind of technical debt showing up in AI applications
Context debt.
You keep adding documents, tools, memories, instructions and conversation history. Eventually the model has everything. But it can't easily tell what actually matters. More context isn't automatically better. It can increase latency, cost and confusion.

A better approach is to treat context like an engineering resource. Retrieve only what the task needs. Remove stale information. Separate instructions from data. Prioritise recent and relevant state. Keep tool outputs concise. Measure whether additional context actually improves results.

This creates an interesting area for developers,

Context management infrastructure. Context compression. Retrieval optimization. Agent memory systems. Prompt caching. Context observability.

The models will keep getting larger context windows. That doesn't mean developers should fill them.
The real skill is knowing what information the model needs at each step.

text: You never know how much you don’t know. Robotics RL is actually difficult. I know the high level reasonings behind the pipeline and the ML aspect but pattern matching is not enough. Why did my run improve by 2% and then crash to 100% failure? The KL term is too low for the learning rate. The critic’s gradient is too high. The physics engine isn’t accurate and causes grasping to fail. The tactile sensors are creating nans. All of the sensors are making training very slow. Does the sim actually transfer to real. The hz in sim is high compared to the inputs we get in real. The policy isn’t moving the robot. Too little generalization. The entropy was turned to 0 because it was most efficient to do nothing because of a simple reward error and we kept it for 3 days. Physics sim and had a fp32 vs fp64 replay error. Don’t even get me started with the numerous lies Astra told me that cost me days and also the thousand I spent in credits. I’m not even talking about reward shaping, the real aspect, or how painful it was to do data collection. That’s exactly why Wendy decided that we need to standardize development and make it really easy for everyone to deploy and test out policies. Most companies and people I talked to are not the goats at all subjects (except Wendy people ;)). Most people have their niche areas and get really good at it. The people that are RL experts and know hardware very well and specifically robotics are incredibly rare. But thankfully, it’s the most fun field in the world. Happy building everyone ;)

text:
这是一个美丽的误会 🤣 

主要是持仓保证金 vs 开仓保证金  之争

背景知识：
1. 网格策略是一个动态的策略 - 它会一直频繁平仓开仓（按照你的设置0.04%（5u的距离）之内放了100个grid，差不多就是每0.05u 一个grid，这非常的密集。。）

bn的grid的规则是，成交的同时会在另一侧给你摆单子（其他人take了就算做是你的盈利 matched trade）；但是如果一直没人take，那么这个东西就会成为unmatched profit / loss

grid是怎么弄的呢？比如125.5的long成交了，但就在125.55摆一个close long，假设这个close long没有被take，就一直放在哪里，计入unmatched pnl

好处就是，假设价格在一个区间内震荡，那这个价差就吃得很爽；坏处就是，突然单边的话，你一侧的单子都要承压 - 这个会吃掉你的保证金

2. 保证金可以分成几种：持仓初始保证金，开仓保证金，维持保证金， - 你这里的主要问题是开仓保证金耗尽了。。而开仓保证金耗尽按照bn的规矩也是终止的条件之一

3. 网格重启后的的动作：先卖出减仓，再补买单 （这个是重点，后面会考） 

在你的案例里 - 反弹时，机器人先执行上方挂着的平多卖单。卖出一格的数量后，再到下面一格挂买单，等价格回落时接回来。

我没看到具体的order flow，所以我猜测是：
第一次碰到122的时候没事，是因为你这个时候122的单子是之前就开好的。。 （钱已经花出去了） 

跌到122，最后一格买入成交
机器人买入53.79 SOXL，然后在约122.05挂出同样数量的平多卖单。

价格随后跌到118，这个122.05的卖单暂时成交不了，然后unmatched loss就一直在增加 （蚕食你为数不多的开仓保证金）

然后第二次到达122的时候，grid就重新启动 -触发新一轮的买单回补

价格反弹进入区间、平多卖单成交后，机器人会尝试在下方补挂买单。这个动作可能触发新的保证金检查。如果下单因保证金不足失败，策略可能终止

你可以理解成：
第一次下跌时，122买单可能是此前就挂好的订单；第二次反弹时，平多成交可能触发新的买单申请 aka你需要花钱开单 （注意：开单的保证金与持仓保证金不是同一个体系） ，而这个时候因为unmatched pnl等问题，你的开仓保证金已经不够了。。 

已存在的订单与新申请订单，检查时点不同。这就能解释“为什么偏偏在反弹时暴露问题”。。。

换句话，这时：

1. 不发生新的开仓申请，仓位可以继续存在。

2. 一旦网格申请补挂开仓单，就可能遇到资金不足。

3.如果系统因此终止策略，再执行你开仓时选择的“终止全平” —— 这个就是你看到“是反弹时被全部平仓” 

知其然，且知其所以然

我在上个牛市、上上个牛市的时候，从没有人跟我讲过这个道理，但我现在很想把这段话分享给新人们，算是肺腑之言了：

这个世界上努力的人很多，真正能拿到大结果的人永远只是少数，所以如果你到现在还没有赚到很多钱，也没有抓住所谓的人生大机会，真的不用气馁，更不需要焦虑，因为很多时候真正把人拖垮的，并不是暂时没有结果，而是在一个离金钱很近、所有人都在展示结果的环境里，不知不觉开始拿自己和别人比较，别人赚钱，你觉得自己落后，别人暴富，你觉得自己错过，最后每天接收了大量信息，却只留下了内耗。

越是在这种时候，越要安住其心，把注意力从别人身上收回来，从纷乱的信息里只提取真正对自己有用的东西，然后继续照顾好自己的身体、情绪、判断和节奏。

你要记得，这个世界本来就是你一个人的游戏，别人比你快一点、赚得多一点、暂时站得高一点，其实都和你没有那么大的关系，你真正要做的，只是把自己的这一局继续玩好。独善其身，是这个时代最被低估的能力，也是对抗长期内耗最有效的解药。

祝你在这个牛市玩得愉快，也祝你赚到钱之后，心里依获得平静。Love & Peace From 小毛哥 ❤

text:
Sometimes feels like people don’t give @arthur0x the credit he deserves.

He rose to fame as cocky VC wunderkid affiliated with 3AC but the untold story is how he managed to survive and thrive after being likely the single individual fucked over the most by 3AC. Working alongside with him through it gave me insane appreciation for his character and grit and I’m happy to call him my friend. 

For people that don’t know the lore, when 3AC blew up, the liquidators came after @DeFianceCapital’s assets even though DeFiance never benefited from or even knew about any of that leverage.

Due to shitty legal structuring, his position was actually pretty bad and most of the lawyers we consulted told us we had a <10% chance of winning. 

Almost all of Arthur’s net worth was in that fund and he wasn’t allowed to use those funds to pay legal fees. Most LPs didn’t want to contribute. Bro was just selling any asset he had that was somewhat liquid (his NFTs, his car etc) to keep fighting against the estate’s unlimited money (some of which was literally his).

I recall an incident where a lawyer told him about how bad his chances were. This mf, under the stress of potentially losing everything, smiles and dropped one of the coldest lines ever. 

“Look at the name of my fund.”

Another time, when I was driving him home from a meeting with our lawyers I had a serious chat with him. I said “Bro as a friend, do you want to start thinking about asset protection? Cover your downside.”

He told me no. I pressed that he might lose everything, that the liquidators might try to squeeze him personally for more.

“If I lose everything I’ll just start again from zero.”

We even had a lawyer suggest given we custodied the disputed assets that Arthur just fuck off to Taiwan with the money to force the liquidators to settle with him rather than stay in Singapore bc it’s harder to enforce overseas. 

He refused bc he didn’t believe he should run when he’s in the right “even though I like Taiwan”.

Eventually we navigated it together towards a settlement that although was incredibly unfair on the facts (tbh anything less than 100% felt unfair), still provided far more recovery than our lawyers (and even his LPs) expected.

You really see people’s true character when the chips are down and Arthur has a force of will and self-conviction I’ve never seen in anyone else before. 

Tiger is right - Eye of the Tiger could literally be his theme music lmao.

author: iruletrenches
quoted_text:
在我的设想中 DeWEB，最终将成为一个横跨所有主流公链的去中心化广域网。
一个真正的去中心化可验证网络，所有开发者的网站、应用APP、消息都部署在上面，它不依赖任何一台中心化服务器存储，消息跨链也不需要笨重的跨链桥，任何人都能简单的验证它是否安全，这次点击是否没有恶意授权。我希望它成为未来所有可验证网络服务的底层基础设施。
这张网建基于 TapeOut Protocol上，它分两层：
第一层是存储和访问：网站或 DApp 的整套前端，存储在 TapeOut 的电路容器中，直接写在公链L1中，与合约同一层。开发者上传的时支付一次公链gas，从此以后，这个网站就永久可以被任何人访问，永久免费存储，不会因为服务器没钱到期而关闭、域名不付费而无法被人抢走。用户访客打开DeWEB网站不需要钱包，不需要签名，不需要支付1分钱 gas，通过电路容器ID坐标就能立即访问，体验和今天的 Web2 网站一模一样。
第二层是 TapeKit，我做的那个DeWEB开源浏览器内核。它负责把电路容器中存储的网站一块一块读回来，每读一块都同时问几家互不相干的节点，答案一致、哈希对得上就显示。整个过程不经过任何中心化服务，甚至不经过 DNS 解析。任何人都可以直接去链上看这个网站的前端代码，有没有恶意脚本、有没有偷偷让你授权钱包，一查就知道。你可以用内置 TapeKit 内核的浏览器或 App 打开任何DeWEB网站，也可以什么都不装，用普通浏览器通过 HashPort的DNS绑定传统web2域名，让任何用户可以通过全世界任何一个普通浏览器通过绑定的网址去访问。我希望，它能兼容所有一切！
为什么很难被屏蔽呢？因为网站不在任何一台服务器上，它是链上账本的一部分，全球节点各存一份，你能连上其中任意两家，页面就出来了。它没有 IP，没有DNS，也没有域名，访问地址也不是哪个机构登记的，而是一个TapeOut的电路容器路径。
除了网站，我刚刚开发了另一个重要的DeWEB 基础设施，一条用于横跨所有公链的实时加密消息通道，我给它起名叫 TapeSend，我在Github中已经将它完全彻底的开源，并且采用MIT协议，这意味着任何生态开发者都可以使用它进行无需我许可的商业化服务。由于我们TapeOut的开发者众多，甚至我还贴心的给你们开源了基本达到了商业化标准的DeWEB客户端，任何人无需修改即可上线运营，立即拥有自己的商业化app。开源代码提供了MAC版、WEB版、IOS版、Android版。
TapeSend 让每一个电路容器都拥有了可以跨公链进行实时加密消息传输的通道。它有这几个特点：
第一，端到端加密。消息在你自己的设备上加密，只有收件人能解开，链上存的是加密文本，任何人都无法得知交流的内容。
第二，钥匙就是你的钱包。消息传递的钥匙由你钱包的签名推导出来，不用另记密码，换一台设备，用同一个钱包签一次名就找回来了。
第三，身份没法冒充。谁是发信人，由链上谁持有这个电路容器决定。容器转让了，收信的权利也跟着新主人走，哦，如果要卖掉，可以通过更换钥匙清理聊天记录，厉害吧，我想的细不，哈哈哈哈。
第四，消息跨链传递不需要跨链桥。消息写在发送者自己的链上，收件人的客户端同时去读几条链，合并成一个传递通道。没有桥，就没有桥被黑、资产被锁的风险。
第五，不需要中心化索引服务器。消息通道列表本身就存在链上，客户端直接读链。
第六，几秒就到。消息上链之后，对方几秒内就能看到。
第七，附件可以核对。消息可以带附件，客户端会逐个核对附件的指纹。不过，双方如果在同一条链上，还可以附带资产一起发送，比如送点BNB给我，哈哈。
既然我设想中的 DeWEB 是一个横跨所有主要公链的去中心化广域网，它就必须海纳百川，在基础设施上，需要支持更多主流公链。
所以，今天我正式宣布：TapeOut Protocol已经在 X Layer 主网部署完毕。处理器工厂、电路容器、网站仓库、TapeSend 消息中枢全部上线，X Layer 上的第一台处理器我已经创建测试完成，电路容器已经开通。不过所有社区用户无需担心，这是技术层面的扩展，不会对现有BEM为主的经济体系造成任何影响。PoD挖矿功能相关的全部经济体系，以及地位。但是会促进更多的开发者加入其中，一起让协议生态更加强大！
这意味着什么呢？未来，持有 X Layer 电路容器的用户，可以用自己的 X Layer 电路容器 ID，和 BNB Chain 电路容器的持有者，通过 TapeSend 互相传递端到端的加密消息。不需要换链，也不需要跨链桥。我自己已经用 X Layer 的 1.2.0 和 BNB Chain 的 15324.30 来回传递了消息，请查看我下面的视频，另外这个视频中的APP我完整开源了，你们可以下载修改，做出更好的app然后上架运营，记得app中帮TapeOut生态继续呐喊，努力让tape成为HTTP。
名字里的区号，就是为更多公链准备的。BNB Chain 是第一个序列，因此地址不带区号，比如 4246.0，X Layer 的区号是 2，比如 1.2.0。同一套 TapeKit 内核，输入不同的地址，就能打开不同链上的网站、给不同公链的电路容器发消息。
TapeOut的愿景，是让区块链能承载可验证的生产工具，而不只是承载公共账本。今天开始，所有 Web2 的网站和应用，都可以迁移到 DeWEB 层：前端放在链上，任何人都能审计；用户访问无需花任何 gas，开发者也可以拥有无限期的前端存储器，没有人能被一键关停，或者被任何机构限制访问；跨链消息通道基于端到端加密，身份由电路容器ID保证。我希望让所有用户，安心地用上安全的、可验证的去中心化网络服务。
哦，最后说一句，HashPort的开发团队经过我与他们的长谈，他们为了帮助实现TapeOut的终极愿景，完全放弃了月服务费，甚至放弃了DNS绑定服务的费用。感谢你们的帮助！让生态更完美！

text:
We do not teach how insurance works in the US school system, and I think that’s unfortunate. It also doesn’t help that the insurance most people think of first is health insurance, which in the US is more of a cost-sharing plan than insurance.

So let’s quickly go over what insurance is and how it works financially.

At its core, insurance is a bet against yourself. It’s a hedge. 

When you pay your car insurance premium, you are betting that you will get into an accident. When you pay your homeowners insurance premium, you are betting that your house will burn down or be flattened in a hurricane. When you pay life insurance premiums, you are betting that you will die young/soon.

Of course, we all have strong incentives NOT to get into a car crash, let our house be damaged, or kick the bucket. This is what is called an insurable interest - it’s why you can’t take our insurance on someone else’s car and then slam the brakes right in front of them - to minimize moral hazard.

If everything goes well - you drive safely, hurricanes skip your house, you live to life expectancy - then congratulations! You win. Although it may feel like those premiums were wasted, you paid them at the time because you didn’t know the future.

So how does it work? The insurance company does some actuarial math to estimate if there are 10,000 people in a life insurance product, how many will die and what benefits will need to be paid out in an average year.

While no one can predict when YOU die (except perhaps you, who have better info about yourself than any doctor or insurer), it’s possible to predict the PROBABILITY you will die in any given year. Not helpful individually, but across thousands of people this becomes useful to the insurer. The more people within an insured group, the more accurate.

This is the Law of Large Numbers. Just like any given coin flip is unpredictable, you can be relatively certain that 100 flips will be around 50% heads, and 100k flips even closer to 50% heads. As the number of flips (or insured persons) grows, realized outcomes converge on the expected probability.

If you’re clever, you will already notice that highly predictable outcomes are bad things to insure against. Why? Because the insurer will be better at predicting it than you, so will just charge you the cost + some profit.

This is, counterintuitively, why a lot of preventative care is forced to be covered by law and bundled with other medical coverage.

If the insurer knows you will - roughly very 12 months - go in for a yearly physical, and that physical usually costs, say,  $100, then they will just build $100 into their expected loss and charge you for it via premiums.

This is actually a bad deal for you, because insurance is pretty costly to administer both by nature and for important compliance reasons. So a near-certainty of $100 paid every January tends to require >$100 in spending. And insurers have to pay their employees and rent and other expenses so that gets added to the premium as well.

For similar reasons, SMALL amounts are impractical for insurance.

So what is insurance good for? LARGE, UNPREDICTABLE expenses.

And in the ideal insurance model, the expenses are far in the future. That allows the insurer to invest the premiums during that time lag.

This is underappreciated! Commonly, insurers in competitive markets take in LESS in premium payments than they pay out. The investment returns on the float over time is what allows a competitive insurance market to function so efficiently.

Returning to the original poster, her husband is clearly on term life insurance. And the premiums are rising because the odds of his dying continue to rise (everyone converges on ☠️ eventually). At some point, the odds of dying over a year become >50% and he becomes basically uninsurable at any reasonable price.

Whole life is a little different. It’s kind of like a pension where you pay in enough to underwrite your entire life and not just next year 1/2

text:
昨晚爆拉不是利好突然来了，是空头先扛不住了

昨晚我判断BTC只要守住77000美元，就会冲击80000美元，并继续测试82000-83000美元。

目前最高已经来到81600美元附近，方向基本兑现，只是速度比我预期更快。

原因不复杂。

加息、鹰派点阵图和监管法案受阻都已经落地，但BTC始终没有跌破75000-76000美元，利空砸不动，空头自然开始紧张。

与此同时，现货ETF由连续流出转为两天净流入约5.9亿美元，美国监管预期也在回暖，现货资金先把价格推上80000美元，随后空头止损，又把涨幅进一步放大。

技术面上，BTC已经站上4小时MA30、MA120和MA200，MACD继续放量，多头重新拿回主动权，不过RSI和KDJ都进入超买区，81600-82300美元又是前方压力，现在追高的盈亏比并不好。

月底前重点看三个位置：
守住80000美元，行情继续偏强，上看84000-85000美元。
跌破79000美元，说明突破还要重新确认，价格可能回踩78000美元。
重新跌破77500美元，这轮上涨才算明显失败。

我认为九月剩余时间震荡偏多，但82000美元上方才是真正的考验，利空不跌，说明筹码在变强；放量站稳82300美元，才算趋势反转，站不稳，仍然只是一次强势反弹。
author: cloakmk
quoted_text:
加息后 bitcoin:native 从7.5万反弹到7.8万附近震荡！

但真正值得注意的是，美联储加息、美元和美债走强、ETF流出，这么多利空压下来，7.5万美元居然没被砸穿。

4小时连续收出下影线，低点逐步抬高，随后突破下降趋势线，MACD金叉，动能柱放大。

但现在谈反转，还是早了。

KDJ已经进入高位，短周期RSI接近超买，7.85万至8万美元又是均线和筹码压力区，突破时成交量并没有明显放大，说明这轮上涨更多来自抛压减弱和空头回补，真正的增量资金还没全面进场。

ETF连续两日流出约7.46亿美元后，最新一个交易日重新流入约1.6亿美元，机构没有撤退，7.5万美元附近也确实有人接，但这笔钱目前更像托底，还不足以把BTC直接推上8.2万美元。

所以九月剩余时间，我更倾向先冲击7.9万-8万美元，再回踩确认。

回踩7.7万美元不破，说明原来的趋势线已经由压力转为支撑，后面继续看8.2万-8.3万美元。

如果冲高后重新跌破7.6万美元，这次突破就可能是假动作，7.5万美元还要再考验一次。

站稳8.3万美元，这轮熊市反弹才有资格升级为趋势反转；跌破7.24万美元，所谓抗跌就只是延迟下跌，后面要防6.96万美元。

短线可以对反弹乐观，但别对反转太自信，之前的经验告诉我一旦盲目乐观，被市场教育就不远了！

$HOOD 翻倍之际，回顾一下来时路：

开始关注回调后的 $HOOD ，还提到Robinhood 开始开拓预测市场。

7 月底，财报出来后，加码继续舔。
Robinhood Banking 突破 30 亿美元存款，有超过三分之一的用户把工资直接打进 Robinhood。
我当时的判断已经是，野心勃勃的 Robinhood 不只是一家券商了。

https://t.co/dfsrWs1c3S

8月中旬，停不了，根本停不了。
我又继续写了公链，股票交易量和预测市场。

8月下旬，深度复盘了 $HOOD 代币化趋势，再舔一波。

https://t.co/aiiP0ARhDs

8月的最后一天，我分享了 3 个在 $HOOD 链上很火，机制也新颖的项目。
https://t.co/2iNkzghUgJ

9 月初，继续分享 RWAFi ，探讨股票代币给 Meme 当交易对和 LP 底仓的新玩法，还顺带推荐了几个标。

https://t.co/4pSKNfPLYP

时间来到现在，
SEC 给代币化美股开绿灯， 直接给了五年监管豁免。
利好 Robinhood，目前在欧洲，它已经提供代币化股票这个服务了。在现有的模式下，每枚代币化股票都有真实股票 1:1 托管 ，也可以获得股息。

从预测市场，到 Robinhood Banking，到 Robinhood Chain，再到代币化趋势，链上生态，
到了现在， SEC 终于开绿灯。

3 个月，全程看好。
author: sanyuanVC
quoted_text:
当大家都把焦点放在 AI和半导体，我反而开始看回调后的 $HOOD

最近因为比特币跌到 6 万美元，交易情绪降温， $HOOD 股价也有所回调

不过我发现一个有意思的变化

Robinhood 第一季营收10.7 亿美元，同比增长 15%，每股收益0.38 美元。
加密收入则因为市场降温，同比下降 47%，但它的其他交易收入却增长 320%，达到 1.47 亿美元，这个主要来自预测市场的收入。

这代表 Robinhood 现在已经不只是一个普通美股券商

它已经认真切入预测市场，想和 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 竞争这一块蛋糕。

不同的是，它们各自的定位并不一样
Robinhood 是在主流券商入口里加入预测市场功能。

Polymarket 更像币圈原生预测市场
Kalshi 则是受监管的原生预测市场交易所

更重要的是，Robinhood 本来就拥有庞大的用户基数，这些用户已经习惯在同一个平台买股票、做期权、交易加密。

现在再加入预测市场，代表有更多交易场景都可以留在Robinhood。

第一季其实已经看到一点变化，事件合约交易量开始增长，相关收入也大幅增长。
虽然 Polymarket 和 Kalshi 现在还是预测市场里的主要玩家，但 Robinhood 的优势是用户入口。只要把预测市场融入原本的平台，可能会慢慢改变用户习惯。

以前大家都觉得 $HOOD 是散户炒股神器。但现在来看，我觉得它的野心不止于此。

我会把它看成一家不断扩张金融生态的公司，把股票、期权、加密、预测市场这些业务串联在一起。

8 月 5 号会公布第二季度财报，财报前我会逐步建仓。

如果这条路真的走通，Robinhood 的故事，可能才刚刚开始。

author: AnselFang
quoted_text:
在我的设想中 DeWEB，最终将成为一个横跨所有主流公链的去中心化广域网。
一个真正的去中心化可验证网络，所有开发者的网站、应用APP、消息都部署在上面，它不依赖任何一台中心化服务器存储，消息跨链也不需要笨重的跨链桥，任何人都能简单的验证它是否安全，这次点击是否没有恶意授权。我希望它成为未来所有可验证网络服务的底层基础设施。
这张网建基于 TapeOut Protocol上，它分两层：
第一层是存储和访问：网站或 DApp 的整套前端，存储在 TapeOut 的电路容器中，直接写在公链L1中，与合约同一层。开发者上传的时支付一次公链gas，从此以后，这个网站就永久可以被任何人访问，永久免费存储，不会因为服务器没钱到期而关闭、域名不付费而无法被人抢走。用户访客打开DeWEB网站不需要钱包，不需要签名，不需要支付1分钱 gas，通过电路容器ID坐标就能立即访问，体验和今天的 Web2 网站一模一样。
第二层是 TapeKit，我做的那个DeWEB开源浏览器内核。它负责把电路容器中存储的网站一块一块读回来，每读一块都同时问几家互不相干的节点，答案一致、哈希对得上就显示。整个过程不经过任何中心化服务，甚至不经过 DNS 解析。任何人都可以直接去链上看这个网站的前端代码，有没有恶意脚本、有没有偷偷让你授权钱包，一查就知道。你可以用内置 TapeKit 内核的浏览器或 App 打开任何DeWEB网站，也可以什么都不装，用普通浏览器通过 HashPort的DNS绑定传统web2域名，让任何用户可以通过全世界任何一个普通浏览器通过绑定的网址去访问。我希望，它能兼容所有一切！
为什么很难被屏蔽呢？因为网站不在任何一台服务器上，它是链上账本的一部分，全球节点各存一份，你能连上其中任意两家，页面就出来了。它没有 IP，没有DNS，也没有域名，访问地址也不是哪个机构登记的，而是一个TapeOut的电路容器路径。
除了网站，我刚刚开发了另一个重要的DeWEB 基础设施，一条用于横跨所有公链的实时加密消息通道，我给它起名叫 TapeSend，我在Github中已经将它完全彻底的开源，并且采用MIT协议，这意味着任何生态开发者都可以使用它进行无需我许可的商业化服务。由于我们TapeOut的开发者众多，甚至我还贴心的给你们开源了基本达到了商业化标准的DeWEB客户端，任何人无需修改即可上线运营，立即拥有自己的商业化app。开源代码提供了MAC版、WEB版、IOS版、Android版。
TapeSend 让每一个电路容器都拥有了可以跨公链进行实时加密消息传输的通道。它有这几个特点：
第一，端到端加密。消息在你自己的设备上加密，只有收件人能解开，链上存的是加密文本，任何人都无法得知交流的内容。
第二，钥匙就是你的钱包。消息传递的钥匙由你钱包的签名推导出来，不用另记密码，换一台设备，用同一个钱包签一次名就找回来了。
第三，身份没法冒充。谁是发信人，由链上谁持有这个电路容器决定。容器转让了，收信的权利也跟着新主人走，哦，如果要卖掉，可以通过更换钥匙清理聊天记录，厉害吧，我想的细不，哈哈哈哈。
第四，消息跨链传递不需要跨链桥。消息写在发送者自己的链上，收件人的客户端同时去读几条链，合并成一个传递通道。没有桥，就没有桥被黑、资产被锁的风险。
第五，不需要中心化索引服务器。消息通道列表本身就存在链上，客户端直接读链。
第六，几秒就到。消息上链之后，对方几秒内就能看到。
第七，附件可以核对。消息可以带附件，客户端会逐个核对附件的指纹。不过，双方如果在同一条链上，还可以附带资产一起发送，比如送点BNB给我，哈哈。
既然我设想中的 DeWEB 是一个横跨所有主要公链的去中心化广域网，它就必须海纳百川，在基础设施上，需要支持更多主流公链。
所以，今天我正式宣布：TapeOut Protocol已经在 X Layer 主网部署完毕。处理器工厂、电路容器、网站仓库、TapeSend 消息中枢全部上线，X Layer 上的第一台处理器我已经创建测试完成，电路容器已经开通。不过所有社区用户无需担心，这是技术层面的扩展，不会对现有BEM为主的经济体系造成任何影响。PoD挖矿功能相关的全部经济体系，以及地位。但是会促进更多的开发者加入其中，一起让协议生态更加强大！
这意味着什么呢？未来，持有 X Layer 电路容器的用户，可以用自己的 X Layer 电路容器 ID，和 BNB Chain 电路容器的持有者，通过 TapeSend 互相传递端到端的加密消息。不需要换链，也不需要跨链桥。我自己已经用 X Layer 的 1.2.0 和 BNB Chain 的 15324.30 来回传递了消息，请查看我下面的视频，另外这个视频中的APP我完整开源了，你们可以下载修改，做出更好的app然后上架运营，记得app中帮TapeOut生态继续呐喊，努力让tape成为HTTP。
名字里的区号，就是为更多公链准备的。BNB Chain 是第一个序列，因此地址不带区号，比如 4246.0，X Layer 的区号是 2，比如 1.2.0。同一套 TapeKit 内核，输入不同的地址，就能打开不同链上的网站、给不同公链的电路容器发消息。
TapeOut的愿景，是让区块链能承载可验证的生产工具，而不只是承载公共账本。今天开始，所有 Web2 的网站和应用，都可以迁移到 DeWEB 层：前端放在链上，任何人都能审计；用户访问无需花任何 gas，开发者也可以拥有无限期的前端存储器，没有人能被一键关停，或者被任何机构限制访问；跨链消息通道基于端到端加密，身份由电路容器ID保证。我希望让所有用户，安心地用上安全的、可验证的去中心化网络服务。
哦，最后说一句，HashPort的开发团队经过我与他们的长谈，他们为了帮助实现TapeOut的终极愿景，完全放弃了月服务费，甚至放弃了DNS绑定服务的费用。感谢你们的帮助！让生态更完美！

开源 TapeKit 地址：https://t.co/81494DTQij

quoted_text:
🚨 SlowMist TI Alert: FomoPeek App v1.1–1.2 Asset Theft 🚨

We have recently received multiple reports of users having assets stolen. Our investigation found that the affected cases involved private key exposure, and some of the users had previously installed and used @FomoPeek App versions 1.1–1.2.

A joint investigation by the @SlowMist_Team and @okx security teams confirmed that the app contains malicious code.⚠️

Besides its normal features, FomoPeek includes two modules that are unrelated to its stated business functions. One of them contains an #iOS kernel exploitation framework with eight different exploit methods. The framework can automatically choose an attack method based on the device model and iOS version.

‼️Affected iOS versions: iOS 12.0–18.7 and iOS 26.0–26.1.‼️

If the exploit succeeds, the app may escape the iOS sandbox, access and decrypt Keychain data, and read files belonging to other apps on the device.

🔐 This means sensitive data stored on the device, including private keys, seed phrases, login credentials, chat history, and files, may be exposed.

The app also connects to hidden servers that are unrelated to its public-facing services and can receive remote commands.

Based on plaintext traffic captured during our analysis, the attack functionality is currently enabled and runs automatically at regular intervals. In general, devices running older iOS versions are at higher risk.

If you have installed or used FomoPeek versions 1.1–1.2, we recommend that you take action immediately:

1️⃣ Check your accounts and assets for any unusual activity.
2️⃣ On a trusted device where FomoPeek has never been installed, create a new account and generate a new private key and seed phrase.
3️⃣ Move your assets to the new account as soon as possible.
4️⃣ Update your device to the latest available iOS version.
5️⃣ Do not continue using or reinstalling FomoPeek.
6️⃣ If you notice any suspicious asset activity, contact the official support team of the relevant platform and keep the affected device and related evidence for further investigation.

🚨 SlowMist TI Alert: FomoPeek App v1.1–1.2 Asset Theft 🚨

We have recently received multiple reports of users having assets stolen. Our investigation found that the affected cases involved private key exposure, and some of the users had previously installed and used @FomoPeek App versions 1.1–1.2.

A joint investigation by the @SlowMist_Team and @okx security teams confirmed that the app contains malicious code.⚠️

Besides its normal features, FomoPeek includes two modules that are unrelated to its stated business functions. One of them contains an #iOS kernel exploitation framework with eight different exploit methods. The framework can automatically choose an attack method based on the device model and iOS version.

‼️Affected iOS versions: iOS 12.0–18.7 and iOS 26.0–26.1.‼️

If the exploit succeeds, the app may escape the iOS sandbox, access and decrypt Keychain data, and read files belonging to other apps on the device.

🔐 This means sensitive data stored on the device, including private keys, seed phrases, login credentials, chat history, and files, may be exposed.

The app also connects to hidden servers that are unrelated to its public-facing services and can receive remote commands.

Based on plaintext traffic captured during our analysis, the attack functionality is currently enabled and runs automatically at regular intervals. In general, devices running older iOS versions are at higher risk.

If you have installed or used FomoPeek versions 1.1–1.2, we recommend that you take action immediately:

1️⃣ Check your accounts and assets for any unusual activity.
2️⃣ On a trusted device where FomoPeek has never been installed, create a new account and generate a new private key and seed phrase.
3️⃣ Move your assets to the new account as soon as possible.
4️⃣ Update your device to the latest available iOS version.
5️⃣ Do not continue using or reinstalling FomoPeek.
6️⃣ If you notice any suspicious asset activity, contact the official support team of the relevant platform and keep the affected device and related evidence for further investigation.

text:
LangChain 的 这份分享有点意思喔。😁 我想，很快，各家 coding agent 都会有分类器出现了。

它介绍了怎么用 Jev 给 agent 搭 harness。Jev 是 @typesafeai 刚发布的模型，只做分类决策，官方数据显示，比同类 LLM 快 200 倍、便宜 400 倍。

Agent loop 的问题在于每一步决策都要调一次模型，相对地，慢且贵。Jev 的思路是把“判断”和“生成”拆开：你把 state 和一组问题发给它，它并行返回带概率的结构化答案。支持三种问题类型：
- Choice：从选项里选一个，返回每个选项的概率
- Score：比如，按 low / medium / high 这类有序等级打分
- Noul：是非题，返回命题为真的概率

一次请求里可以问多个问题，都是并行评估，多个问题几乎不增加延迟。

LangChain 把它封装成了 TypeSafeClassifier，还给了两个 middleware 示例：
- ModelRouterMiddleware：让 Jev 先判断请求难度，简单任务走便宜模型，复杂任务走更强的模型。
- AutoModeMiddleware：在工具调用执行前用 Jev 检查是否危险，危险就拦下来。

作者提到 claude、codex、cursor 这类 coding harness 都有类似的分类器，但很可惜，都是封装在闭源部分。现在有了便宜的分类模型，任何 agent 都能实现这个模式。

text:
I’ve built Patrik OS, a personal AI operations and decision system that runs across my three computers.

It connects my projects, files, history, work queues, current status, model capacity, operating rules and next actions. Each task gets the right context, is sent to the right tool or model, and remains subject to clear decision and execution boundaries.

PKI handles deterministic local discovery. Remio (@remio_ai) provides long-term memory and context across sources. JEV from TypeSafe AI (@typesafeai), co-founded by Diogo Almeida (@CompleteSkeptic), acts as a fast, typed decision layer for routing, work-item triage, project phase and text quality.

Astra and Sol from OpenAI (@OpenAI) handle planning and deeper reasoning. Codex, led by Tibo (@thsottiaux), manages local files, system state, implementation and verification.

My next step is to test JEV as a memory gate: retrieve 20–50 candidate passages, rank them, and send only the best 3–8 to the larger model. That should reduce irrelevant context and expensive model calls.

.@NEARProtocol has launched confidential perpetual futures on https://t.co/Twm87UR07N, with execution still running on @HyperliquidX.

Why does this matter?
On transparent perps, large wallets can become a strategy leak.

Traders can be copied, tracked or targeted simply by watching onchain activity.

NEAR is trying to combine:
Hyperliquid’s liquidity + onchain settlement + more confidential trading rails.

Your position is still visible at the market level. Size and side can still appear on the order book.

So this is not fully private perps.

Your trading activity can be harder to link back to your wallet, while the market itself remains transparent.

If this works at scale, it could become an interesting alternative for whales, institutions, and trading agents that want onchain execution without exposing their wallet identity.

The real test now is whether traders actually move volume toward confidential frontends and whether the privacy guarantees hold up against serious chain analysis.

quoted_text:
Sequel to AI Pacing

I have now spent more time talking to people who run AI labs, Open Source projects and those in government and infrastructure. 

I am beginning to feel the NINJA move could backfire.  

I understand the pressure to come out and share where AI is "unmanageable ", and constantly share examples where it runs rogue. This fits in the category of "self-reporting" and an attempt to limit liability. Even the bleeding edge research examples are being cast in a negative light. 

Here are the consequences of the NINJA move. 
1. They have successfully encouraged every law maker around the world to have an opinion, and in cases a poorly un-informed one. 
2. By proposing pacing - they have introduced uncertainty in the AI infrastructure trade, because we really don't know when "un-pacing" will begin or what those conditions will be. 
3. The notion that a few leaders can collaborate and self pace is illusory, it takes one breaking ranks to start the race again, it could be a player in a different country or open source or an AI Lab itself. 
4. There will be a regulatory body created as a consequence of this and it will be impossible to balance every stakeholder in this process. 
5. No remedies, tools, solutions are being proposed other than "compute spent on safety", there is no mention of security (which will hamper adoption)

The recommendation is to fix alignment - Alignment is a hard problem - to fix alignment one shouldn't have trained models with "negative behavior". Alignment is a combination of moral standards, right and wrong and guardrails. Whose sensibilities will we align to? Alignment edge cases are hard. I look forward to learning more on this. 

Guardrailing attempts post training have not shown precision. Distillation makes it worse, so AI will continue down it's path of getting smarter, while we will be chasing it to ensure alignment and building guardrails. 

The AI labs have gone from being research projects to wanting to be the largest businesses in the world if they want to continue their progress. Transition from research winners to improving the lot of humanity and partnering with enterprises. Act like the largest companies in the world:
- Demonstrate the positive impacts of AI and how all of us benefit. 
- Show enterprises how you can collaborate to solve real world problems and progress innovation safely and securely. Post an example every day how you helped. 
- Solve the problem with a few players and demonstrate leadership so others can follow. 

It's time to rebuild the brand of AI - any marketing expert will tell you, this Ninja move has done more to harm the brand of AI and will take a while to rebuild. #letsbepositive in our actions and our narrative.

text:
Vercel Labs 工程师 Chris Tate 给 json-render 接入 Jev，开始试验让 AI 在运行时直接组合 UI。

json-render 会提前准备好按钮、卡片、输入框、数据和动作。Jev 不需要像大模型一样逐 Token 写完整 JSON，只负责决定用哪些组件、怎么排序、放在哪里，再交给正常的 UI 渲染器。新界面默认一次判断选出主要组件，需要时再用第二次判断安排布局。

在同一个火车票界面生成演示中，默认 JSONL 模式从请求到完成用了 3.21 秒，Jev 只用了 0.88 秒。

未来 App 的界面可能根本不用完全写死。UI 可以变成运行时决策，同一个 App 面对不同用户、任务和状态，临时拼出不同的页面。Jev 这次演示已经把完整生成时间压到 1 秒以内，至少让这种交互开始有了实时感。

Runway 上月底发布的 Solaris 也在赌类似方向，只是路线更激进。Solaris 用世界模型逐帧生成整个界面，直接绕过传统代码和组件；Jev 仍然使用开发者提前写好的组件和动作，只动态决定怎么组合。

一个想让软件变成实时生成的视频世界，一个更像让软件拥有一张随时重组的脸。

text:
Sometimes feels like people don’t give @arthur0x the credit he deserves.

He rose to fame as cocky VC wunderkid affiliated with 3AC but the untold story is how he managed to survive and thrive after being likely the single individual fucked over the most by 3AC. Working alongside with him through it gave me insane appreciation for his character and grit and I’m happy to call him my friend. 

For people that don’t know the lore, when 3AC blew up, the liquidators came after @DeFianceCapital’s assets even though DeFiance never benefited from or even knew about any of that leverage.

Due to shitty legal structuring, his position was actually pretty bad and most of the lawyers we consulted told us we had a <10% chance of winning. 

Almost all of Arthur’s net worth was in that fund and he wasn’t allowed to use those funds to pay legal fees. Most LPs didn’t want to contribute. Bro was just selling any asset he had that was somewhat liquid (his NFTs, his car etc) to keep fighting against the estate’s unlimited money (some of which was literally his).

I recall an incident where a lawyer told him about how bad his chances were. This mf, under the stress of potentially losing everything, smiles and dropped one of the coldest lines ever. 

“Look at the name of my fund.”

Another time, when I was driving him home from a meeting with our lawyers I had a serious chat with him. I said “Bro as a friend, do you want to start thinking about asset protection? Cover your downside.”

He told me no. I pressed that he might lose everything, that the liquidators might try to squeeze him personally for more.

“If I lose everything I’ll just start again from zero.”

We even had someone suggest given we custodied the disputed assets that Arthur just fuck off to Taiwan with the money to force the liquidators to settle with him rather than stay in Singapore bc it’s harder to enforce overseas. 

He refused bc he didn’t believe he should run when he’s in the right “even though I like Taiwan”.

Eventually we navigated it together towards a settlement that although was incredibly unfair on the facts (tbh anything less than 100% felt unfair), still provided far more recovery than our lawyers (and even his LPs) expected.

You really see people’s true character when the chips are down and Arthur has a force of will and self-conviction I’ve never seen in anyone else before. 

Tiger is right - Eye of the Tiger could literally be his theme music lmao.

text:
Founders often wait for “audit-ready” code before asking a security question. That is backward.

Before implementation, I want to know:
• where value moves
• who is trusted
• which assumptions can go stale
• who can block or grief the system
• what cannot be safely changed later

Use early review to change the design. Use the later code review to verify what you actually built.

That's why I thought of offering the Founder Security Sprint service.
author: TheBlockChainer
quoted_text:
The cheapest security finding is the one caught before it becomes code.

The Founder Security Sprint service starts with threat modeling while the architecture is still movable. The time-boxed code review can wait until the highest-risk contracts have settled, followed by a findings walkthrough and one fix re-check.

It is deliberately not sold as a full audit. It is a practical security path for founders who need senior eyes before they are ready for one.

Small FAQ on how Crowny works:

We launched 4 days ago alongside the $CROWN token to participate in the AnsemHack by @clawpumptech.

The token generates fees (we keep 75% of it, 25% goes to ClawPump) which us divided as followed:

‣ 10% goes to a random holder (jackpot system)
‣ 90% is kept and used to buy cards using @SP3NDdotshop 

The cards bought are stored in our treasury (public) until a raffle is created for them. For the moment being one raffle at a time, more once we get more popular.

For that reason we included a 70% threshold to every raffle. If it's not met, no winner is drawn and every ticket is refunded. The card is then stored again until it's either raffled again or used for a Free Drop.

"There is no second best", but if there was, it sure as hell wouldn't be ethereum:0x0f2d719407fdbeff09d87557abb7232601fd9f29.  

I mentioned months ago that if you really wanna diversify the on chain options thesis out, ethereum:0xb32e10022ffbedfe10bc818a1c7e67d9d87e0fa7 and $LIT are the only really viable liquid investments outside of ethereum:0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be.

I think the entire sector can 10x in 2027, and each team/token has their own unique value prop and bull case. 

My honest thoughts on the sector:

ethereum:0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be is the massive incumbent obviously. I expect them to be a huge player for all mainnet adjacent derivatives. People genuinely aren't thinking big enough here imo. Structured products like accumulators, principal protected vaults (think $ETH staking yield where the yield goes to buying calls), covered call on chain ETF's, yield products and vaults, etc etc. Options are pretty infinitely programmable DeFi lego blocks and the TAM here is in the trillions. Tons of teams are already building on top of @DeriveXYZ liquidity, and after the v3 update and this price move, I expect way more.

$LIT likely has an inside track on RWAs due to the Robinhood connection. I find this to be a double edged sword though because I don't know how good of PMF on chain RWA options trading will have when you can just... use Robinhood itself. Their RWA perps haven't really gotten great traction relative to @HyperliquidX, but I expect there to be a decent amount of options trading from $LIT bulls happy to keep their money in the ecosystem. Make no mistake about it though, @Lighter_xyz has one of the most technically skilled teams in all of crypto, and they'll absolutely come in swinging. 

@paradex got clowned for their pretty bad ethereum:0xb32e10022ffbedfe10bc818a1c7e67d9d87e0fa7 TGE, but this is still Paradigm with all the rails and expertise that comes with routing half of Deribit volume all these years. Extremely talented team, very heavy focus on privacy. Could see an interesting angle where they do well with AIPAC users and more institutional traders who are used to Paradigm and value privacy more.

@SynapseProtocol actually has a very smart founder, @trajan0x, despite their moronic mascot. They're making the bet that tying into Hyperliquid perp liquidity is a huge advantage. I disagree that traders and market makers value this as heavily as they do since all market makers are already running cross venue, and still most heavily on Binance since that's where all the altcoin spot/perp liquidity still is. However, I think they'll have an interesting angle for pre-IPO equities and pre-TGE tokens since Hyperliquid tends to dominate those markets and that's where the cross margining with HL perps actually does matter. I just think that niche doesn't justify the current valuation yet since the metrics are pretty much zero right now.

There's no realistic world where @DeriveXYZ remains 95% market share in a sector with this much opportunity. I wouldn't be surprised to see them drop to 60-80% market share in 2027, but the market in question grows 10x. Smaller piece of a MUCH bigger pie.

At the end of the day, they're all going to a lot of the same market makers, and liquidity/quotes should tend to coalesce around the same place. What really matters is distribution, interoperability, and moat. I think options do tend to be more winner take all and users/flows are more "sticky" than perps though, and ethereum:0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be pumping also means they'll get more market makers interested in providing liquidity, better distribution through wallet/partner "builder codes", better talent acquisition etc. @DeriveXYZ will be extremely hard to displace, just like Deribit has been despite being asleep at the wheel since their acquisition.

A lot of these teams have been building out options for YEARS, and ethereum:0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be pumping rerates all of them upwards, and I'm happy that all these teams are likely to get rewarded for years of grinding. On chain options will be considerably less zero sum than perps are right now, and all of these can experience huge TAM expansion into their own unique verticals. It's just a huge mistake to think "I missed ethereum:0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be, what's cheaper" imo. If anything, their bull case got much stronger from this pump.

quoted_text:
Two months in review.

Since the start of Perpspad and the introduction of meme-perps as a new pairing mechanism on Solana, we’ve done:

$20M cumulative volume across every Perpspad coin
$7.1M perp volume and climbing on @PhoenixTrade, backing 45 coins
$92K in trading fees claimed onchain through the Meteora SDK
$56K of supply bought back & burnt: 2,537 buybacks, 2,713 burn txs, 1.69B tokens burnt across all coins
$23.5K paid to creators, $5.2K of it paid out in tokenised stocks
$152K open interest held by coin treasuries
More than 1,685,932,406 tokens burnt across all launches.

All these wouldn’t have been achieved without @meteoraag infra under the hood. Most launchpad tokens only have attention behind them. 

A perpspad coin has both the attention and the financialisation engine, which is a leveraged perp position: on BTC, SOL, gold, NVDA, SPY or whatever the creator picks.

The coin's own trading fees fund that position, and its profits buy back and burn the coin. Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve is what makes that loop work.

How we use DBC

Each coin gets its own DBC config. Supply is 1B, and mint and freeze authority are revoked at creation.
Any quote token. Coins can launch against SOL, USDC, tokenised stocks from Backpack and xStocks, and community tokens like $ANSEM or any verified SPL mint.

For live-priced quotes, market-cap targets are set in USD at launch, so a memecoin-quoted curve behaves like an SOL-quoted one.

- Fees are collected in the quote token. Treasuries receive SOL or USDC directly and never have to sell the coin to get paid. That's what lets a keeper fund margin, pay creators and buy back supply on every tick.

- Anti-snipe from the start. An exponential fee scheduler plus Meteora's dynamic fee makes early sniping expensive, and those fees go to the treasury.

- Graduation to DAMM v2 with LP permanently locked. 100% of migrated liquidity is locked, split 50/50 between platform and creator, so nobody can pull it.

- The keeper claims every tick. It calls the Meteora SDK to claim fees on DBC before graduation and on DAMM v2 after. Then it tops up perp margin, pays the creator and routes buybacks through Jupiter to burn. Each step is a mainnet transaction.

Why DBC made this possible

Normally, a token launch with a programmable treasury means writing and auditing your own AMM, fee logic and migration. DBC gives us all of that as configuration: the curve, fee schedule, quote token, fee destination, migration target and LP lock. 

We only had to build the part that's new, which is connecting fees to a perp position and turning profits into burns.

Just as we’ve seen meme stocks become a major driver of stock prices, creating a zeitgeist around certain stocks, meme-perps are also contributing to the growth of @perps volume on Solana.

We’re proud to be bringing more innovation to @solana’s perps ecosystem.

What's next?
⁃ New UI redesign coming up

⁃ More exotic perps will be added, powered by Phoenix.

⁃ UX improvements and more perp strategies

- Fee routing for more launchpads will be supported, including [redacted]

⁃ We started a whole meta of combining memes and perps, and we'll keep on innovating to make the best tek for users and launchers

text:
i hardly share anything personal trading here but here's a story i'd like to share:

as a product nerd, i always love trying new products and was the earliest user of both @Pumpfun and @fomo (joined jul '25) 

i really never traded on them (except few test trades)

but always found both apps to be really inspiring and kept checking every single week - it's been awesome to see how they've added features while always making it dead-simple to use

(ofc, i have always been actively trading elsewhere)

3 weeks ago, i decided to put a small amount: $500 on fomo and $1k on pump

to experience what it's like to put a thesis to every trade and trade completely from mobile

(you can check all my thesis on fomo/pump if you want - generally i do write my thesis for every trade privately to keep learning and now help ai learn)

while trading on pump/fomo, i observed every single interaction from a product pov: load times, stats inconsistency, execution time, slippage, design layouts/flow etc etc

ngl, both fomo & pump still has soooo many bugs - but i learnt so much on what's good, few learnings:

> wallet tracking apps has always been there since '23

but in-app PnL leaderboards on fomo/pump makes it feel like a game (the male urge to climb up is just something different)

and in-app trade execution just removed all potential noise which other tracking apps had - while putting in a familar social UX (eg. 'follow' instead of 'track')

> single unified cash balance to trade any assets on any chain is simple yet great

@RelayProtocol is 🐐 to be the new layer, powering all non-solana trades & deposits for all these apps

i see a future where every trading app is multi-chain by default and chains become more like SaaS w/ liquidity moat

> both pump/fomo's execution/slippage is really bad compared to axiom and there's no limit orders too

but i realised i was trading like a game and i stopped caring after a point because mobile UX is just so smooth (despite being an execution nerd)

> opinionated decision to treat everything as a trade (and not txn): this makes PnL tracking of a trade simple as you essentially cluster all buy/sell txns of a token until you fully sell

and removes so much mental fatigue which you use otherwise face on phantom/jup etc

> callout/creator rewards are cool: the amounts are small for new small size accounts - but the feeling of getting them will drive so many traders (it's like youtube payouts); even when i just got $370 for a callout, i felt like sharing to everyone 

> fomo/pump is still just a showoff ground, i'd say 99% of real social activity & alpha discovery still happens on telegram groups & dms 

(i'm in lot of these groups too ofc to learn and feeling of a group trenching like a clan is something different)

> in trading, greed is always amplified more: but if you look closely, 90% of profiles are red in any time frame (maybe i'll be also red in future) - but that's the whole driving point of social trading (for now)

+ leaderboard is the biggest bait - as unrealised PnLs are the illusion traps which attracts masses

but yeah fast forward, i've now $10k/20x on fomo and $25k/25x on pump (mostly realised - yes, i sell) - all unintentionally, while treating it like a game 🫠

above all: i've now so many new first-hand insights on what'll the future of trading look like and what will traders want (or what i'd love or wish it existed) - can't wait to apply all of them on my dream app: @suzitrade😌

and ofc, i'm always down to try out new products

ps: pls don't try to copy trade me, you'll most likely loose money (and copy trading is for dumb folks) - instead check my trenching thread to learn, i'll keep sharing more

i'm just playing the game to have fun!

author: Jiaxi_Cui
quoted_text:
Yes, classifiers existed. BERT, DeBERTa, GLiNER, fine-tuned heads. Most of them were specialized. Pick the labels, train, ship. Changing the rules at runtime meant another training run.

What we did not have was a general-purpose classifier at Terra / Sonnet 5 level intelligence.

You could fake it by asking an LLM for JSON, but that was slow, expensive, and poorly calibrated.

Jev is that missing piece. Labels defined in code, typed answer plus confidence, no extra LLM call.

Classification is not new. What is new is a general-purpose classifier this intelligent, this fast, and this cheap.

On chain options will be considerably less zero sum than perps are right now, and all of these can experience huge TAM expansion into their own unique verticals. It's just a huge mistake to think "I missed ethereum:0xb1d1eae60eea9525032a6dcb4c1ce336a1de71be, what's cheaper" imo. If anything, their bull case got much stronger from this pump.

text: Institutional adoption depends on infrastructure that can meet an institutional standard.
author: Bastion
quoted_text:
When we started @Bastion, we believed stablecoins would become core financial infrastructure. But for the world’s largest enterprises and financial institutions to adopt them, that infrastructure would need to meet the regulatory standards they already expect from their banks.

That meant building compliance, controls and governance into Bastion from the beginning, not adding them after the fact or waiting for others to pave the way.

Today, the OCC granted Bastion preliminary conditional approval for a national trust bank charter, placing us among a small group of companies to reach this stage with the OCC.

That matters because the bar should be high. Stablecoins are becoming part of the financial system, and the infrastructure powering them needs to be built for the regulatory and operational standards that come with that.

Stablecoins are moving into the financial mainstream, but institutional adoption depends on infrastructure that can meet an institutional standard.

We made the decision early to build Bastion for that standard. Today is an important validation of that decision, and we’re just getting started.

https://t.co/JiCYfQYVBP

text:
In response to my recent article on the danger that AI poses to human cultural institutions, I was sent this 2025 paper by @DavidDuvenaud & co on "Gradual Disempowerment". 

I want to write and research this topic more and discuss it with relevant people. Where should I start?

The TLDR is that I firmly believe this is one of the most pressing challenges of this era. But also relatively unexplored. How we navigate this transition culturally and whether we put the right human and institutional elements in place to steer its direction in a way associated with human flourishing is to me the key question of our age. 

I believe scenarios of "Sudden Disempowerment", where humans simply suddenly lose control or are exterminated get a lot of attention and there are many people doing work on them. I want to work on "Gradual Disempowerment". 

Please suggest ideas!

text:
I’ve given Claude Opus various published papers (and my own unpublished ones) and asked it to review them. (Don’t panic—I’m not uploading confidential manuscripts.)

The reviews it produces are excellent. It finds statistical errors, internal contradictions, and conceptual confusions that human reviewers miss; it provides useful suggestions; it has a good sense of what counts as significant and novel and what doesn’t; and it’s generous in its appreciation for what the authors get right. And it doesn’t suffer from the strong “myside bias” humans have; it doesn’t recommend rejection because the author didn’t cite it enough; it doesn’t insult the authors; and it doesn’t agree to write a review and then never send anything in.

As a journal editor, I’m not sure what to do with this. If I gave up on human reviewers and used GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus instead, my bosses would fire me, probably rightfully so. The only constructive thing I can recommend is that, before submitting something to a journal, researchers and scholars use this tremendously valuable resource. (Just don’t tell the models that it’s your paper, because they do suffer from sycophancy.)

SlowMist: Hackers Implement Full-Chain iOS Exploit to Steal Private Keys and Mnemonic Phrases Across Versions 13 to 26.5

SlowMist Chief Information Security Officer 23pds has issued an urgent security warning advising all iOS users to update their devices immediately. He disclosed that cybercriminals have actively operationalized a full-chain exploit framework capable of silently exfiltrating private keys and mnemonic seed phrases directly from iOS devices.

The attack execution pathway involves: luring targets to a malicious webpage via Safari through social engineering or watering-hole tactics, triggering memory corruption in WebKit/JavaScriptCore (JSC) to secure arbitrary read/write access at the JavaScript layer, subsequently bypassing Pointer Authentication Codes (PAC) to achieve native code execution, escaping the WebContent sandbox, and completing kernel privilege escalation to root to drain device Keychains and local crypto wallet application data. The potentially affected versions are reported to span iOS 13 through iOS 26.5 (pending final confirmation).

Recurrence Flower Kimono Dress | Anime Expo - 2024.07.07

Mathematical art born of extensive computation using my original algorithm, without AI. LUXOPHIA × Hiroko Tokumine bring my CG artwork to kimono-style Lolita fashion, giving an unseen universe tangible form and movement.

“漸花式 (Zenka-shiki): Recurrence Flowers” explores the Mandelbrot set, famous in fractal geometry. Its intricate forms emerge from a single recurrence relation.

I approach this exploration as a photographer, with computer graphics as my camera. Each image captures a fragment of a landscape whose possibilities extend beyond even my own imagination. The process of computation is itself part of the work: a means of discovering forms I could not have anticipated.

Based on Hiroko Tokumine’s signature “Yamato Nadeshiko One-Piece,” the dress combines my mathematical imagery with Wa Lolita—a style that brings elements of traditional Japanese dress into Lolita fashion.

text:
Have you noticed what’s been happening lately?

From @naval  to @mert.

From the teams and founders at @Bitwise, @Delphi_Digital, @multicoin, ...

They’re all talking about $NEAR more, interacting with it more, and paying more attention.

It reminds me a lot of $ZEC in August and September last year, when ZEC was still trading below $50.

My friends, a real 1000x move doesn’t happen in a few weeks or a few months.

It takes years.

Years to shake out weak hands.

Years for supply to get absorbed and accumulated.

Years for the team to keep building, shipping, and proving they can survive brutal market cycles.

That’s why I look at $NEAR right now and feel like everything is lining up almost perfectly.

You don’t get setups like this very often.

Either you see it when it’s there, or you may have to wait a very, very long time for another one.

I know some of you are new here. Or maybe you’re just market nomads, jumping from one narrative to another, one token to another, always chasing “the next thing.”

Crypto will always give you something new to chase.

A new narrative.
A new token.
A new “100x gem.”
A new story pumped hard enough to make you feel like you’re missing out.

But be careful.

A lot of that stuff has never been tested through real market cycles.

You don’t know if the team will still be there when the narrative dies. 

You don’t know if the community will still be there when liquidity dries up. 

And you don’t know if the product can survive when nobody cares anymore.

There’s one simple question from Buffett that always sticks with me:

Why put money into your 20th-best idea when you can put more into your best ones?

The market will never stop throwing new coins, new narratives, and new “100x gems” at you.

But once you find something that has survived, kept building, and proved it belongs, hold it tight.

Don’t ignore it just to chase unproven bets or whatever KOLs are shilling today.

You don’t need every narrative.
You don’t need every new token.

And you definitely don’t need to leave something that took years to prove itself just because something newer is making more noise.

Stop chasing unproven noise.
Focus on what already proved it belongs.

In @ilblackdragon we trust.
Nothing comes NEAR.

author: ChainCatcher_
quoted_text:
⚠️ Security Advisory | iPhone Users: Check Whether You’ve Ever Installed the FomoPeek App

Binance is aware of a security incident recently disclosed by the community. According to security firms including SlowMist, the third-party app FomoPeek (versions 1.1–1.2) contains malicious code that can exploit iOS system vulnerabilities to gain the highest level of device privileges, potentially accessing sensitive data stored on the device, including private keys, seed phrases, login credentials, chat history, files, and more.

Please note that this type of malware targets the device itself. If an attack succeeds, data from all apps on the affected device may be accessed.

Please check the following:

1. Are you using an iPhone or iPad running iOS 26.x or earlier?
2. Have you ever installed the FomoPeek app?

If both apply to you, we recommend taking the following steps immediately:

1. Delete the FomoPeek app and do not reinstall it.
2. Update your iOS to the latest available version.
3. For self-custody wallet users: On a device that has never had the app installed, create a new wallet and transfer your assets to the new wallet address.
4. If you notice any unusual asset activity, preserve the affected device and relevant evidence, and contact Binance Customer Support for further investigation.

We also remind all users: Do not install apps from untrusted sources, and keep your device software up to date.

text:
love brian but ATPs are not an apples-to-apples comparison to vaults. while its good rage bait, it is just making everyone more confused

everything in defi comes down to "strategy" and "custody". a strategy is a managed set of allocations across contracts, and custody sits both above and below the strategy (how do you "hold" a position in the strategy, and how does the strategy "hold" positions across other contracts).

The primary ATP strategy today (an ETF) is safer than a variety of strategies run by vaults. My mental comparison of glider today is against my metamask or coinbase account, not against some steakhouse vault. When glider gets to openly creating and managing strategies that ATPs can allocated into, then we are getting closer to an apples comparison. I believe the complexity of contracts/oracles is unavoidable, you can abstract it with an API sure but it is still there and institutions will still want to audit down through every layer (they aren't going to just sign off on your api). It's not a problem you can just run away from.

I also know I tweet large token graphs often, but more contracts != more risk always. For example, centrifuge has like 30+ contracts just to manage bridging of an asset because they want fallbacks/gates/agreement across different bridges (chainlink, layerzero, and axelar). And if you want to allow different strategies, you have to segment what operations are allowed by what operators (this is the bulk of contracts for any protocol/vault). Privy wallets give glider full authorization to do anything they want on behalf of the user, but eventually that will have to become more segmented like a policied weiroll solution which a few other teams are close to launching (like makinax).

I'm seeing enough confusion on the timeline that it's probably worth me writing an article about the layers of strategy, custody, and operations in defi today.

TypeSafe reports up to 193x faster and 444x cheaper performance in tests with Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra.

1 → LLMs create. Agents act. Jev decides the next move.

2 → Turn agent forks into three primitives: Choice, Score and probability.

3 → Build with OpenAI, Anthropic or xAI first, then swap Jev in without rebuilding the graph.

4 → Start with shared state, parallel decisions, risk thresholds and an execution queue.

5 → Batch decisions instead of making them sequentially. In one test, 13 questions were 10x faster and 12.2x cheaper.

6 → Put Jev at bounded forks: agent, model, tool, browser action or human escalation.

7 → Benchmark the whole loop, not just individual model calls.

8 → Rank wide, read narrow: shortlist first, then spend compute on what matters.

9 → Reuse the same system: State → Questions → Action → Verify.

10 → Keep Jev out of math, writing and irreversible execution. Code computes, LLMs create, Jev decides.

The result:

A slow, expensive agent loop becomes a much faster decision system that can route, score and escalate in milliseconds.

text:
the launchpad is not the thesis for Trade Zone. 

it is the entry point into Quai

start with what makes an L1/L2 ecosystem work:
- networks produce blockspace
- blockspace attracts applications
- applications create assets, markets, liquidity, and culture
- those things attract more users, which creates more demand for the network and its native asset

Solana is probably the clearest example

SOL performed well -> users had more capital to rotate into Solana tokens -> those tokens attracted more volume and attention -> more people needed SOL and entered the Solana ecosystem

SOL helped the memes, and the memes helped SOL

this is reflexive

now compare that with Base or Robinhood Chain

both use ETH for gas so there is no separate Base or Robinhood asset that gives users direct exposure to the growth of those specific ecosystems (outside of large cap stocks)

the apps and tokens can perform extremely well, but the relationship between ecosystem activity and a native asset is less direct

Quai is different

QUAI is the native asset on the fastest Proof of Work EVM chain

but Quai also has QI, the private energy-based flatcoin, with WQI bringing that asset into the smart-contract economy

Trade Zone supports both sides of this monetary system. bonded markets begin against native QUAI or WQI

that means activity does not only create more reasons to acquire and use QUAI. it also gives QI more places to trade, pair, and build liquidity through WQI, helping deepen the markets that support its usefulness and stability

so if Quai-native tokens attract attention, that attention can create demand for QUAI

and if QUAI gains liquidity, users, and value, more capital becomes available for Quai-native tokens

QUAI helps the ecosystem, and the ecosystem helps QUAI

the same loop can help QI from another direction: more WQI markets -> more liquidity and utility -> a stronger energy-based currency inside the Quai economy

the important part is that this loop is only beginning

there are not yet hundreds of dominant Quai applications or established categories. liquidity has not already settled around a handful of winners. the culture and default assets of the ecosystem are still being formed

that makes it riskier, obviously, but it is also what being early actually means

launchpads are useful here because they compress the process of market formation

token creation -> price discovery -> trading -> liquidity -> communities -> new applications

and all of this is happening on a fast Proof-of-Work smart-contract network, secured by miners rather than a company database or a single sequencer

so, sure, Trade Zone is another launchpad

but the interesting part is not the launchpad mechanic

it is the chance to participate early in the feedback loop between Quai applications, Quai-native assets, and the future energy based economy

so the launchpad is not the innovation

the emerging Proof-of-Work economy around it is

We escaped Docker's hypervisor with three lines of bash. CVE-2026-77179: A container gets complete read and write access to the host filesystem.

When you mount a folder into a container, Docker's VMM uses virtio-fs, and the file server runs on the host.

Because of a TOCTOU bug, if a container opens a file, deletes it while holding its file handle open, and replaces the parent folder with a symlink, the kernel will follow the symlink to anywhere on the host.

⚠️ Security Advisory | iPhone Users: Check Whether You’ve Ever Installed the FomoPeek App

Binance is aware of a security incident recently disclosed by the community. According to security firms including SlowMist, the third-party app FomoPeek (versions 1.1–1.2) contains malicious code that can exploit iOS system vulnerabilities to gain the highest level of device privileges, potentially accessing sensitive data stored on the device, including private keys, seed phrases, login credentials, chat history, files, and more.

Please note that this type of malware targets the device itself. If an attack succeeds, data from all apps on the affected device may be accessed.

Please check the following:

1. Are you using an iPhone or iPad running iOS 26.x or earlier?
2. Have you ever installed the FomoPeek app?

If both apply to you, we recommend taking the following steps immediately:

1. Delete the FomoPeek app and do not reinstall it.
2. Update your iOS to the latest available version.
3. For self-custody wallet users: On a device that has never had the app installed, create a new wallet and transfer your assets to the new wallet address.
4. If you notice any unusual asset activity, preserve the affected device and relevant evidence, and contact Binance Customer Support for further investigation.

We also remind all users: Do not install apps from untrusted sources, and keep your device software up to date.

text:
The Economist says AI created a million jobs in America.

I read that twice.

Then I found out who's getting hired and it made total sense.

For two years the only headline was the same one. AI is coming for your job. Learn to code was dead. Entry level was finished. Everyone under thirty was about to be replaced by a chatbot.

So The Economist did the thing nobody else bothered to do. They actually counted.

They lined up every job AI created against every job it killed. The layoffs first, because that's the part everyone was waiting for.

About 200,000 jobs gone since mid 2023. Real people, real pink slips, companies openly blaming AI. Customer service down around 10 percent. Admin and secretary roles down about 15. That part of the fear was true.

Then they counted the other side.

Around a million new jobs. Five made for every one destroyed.

I sat with that number for a second because it's the exact opposite of what I'd been told to expect. Then I looked at where the jobs actually went, and the whole thing clicked.

The biggest winners of the AI boom don't touch a keyboard.

They're electricians.

Here's the part nobody explains. AI doesn't live in the cloud. The cloud is a lie we tell ourselves. AI lives in enormous buildings full of computers that run hot enough to cook an egg, and those buildings have to be built, wired, cooled, and fed more power than a small city.

So the money went there.

Around 320,000 more jobs than normal in the industries that build these things. Electricians. HVAC techs. The people who wire electrical equipment. Utility crews. Companies are so desperate for them that data center jobs pay about 40 percent more than the same work anywhere else.

The white collar side grew too. Roughly 730,000 above trend in the jobs sitting closest to AI. Engineers, software people, data scientists, plus a wave of roles that didn't exist three years ago like the people who label training data and the ones who bolt these systems into real companies.

Even the jobs everyone said were doomed kept growing. Paralegals up 11 percent. Market research analysts up 6. The national average was around 2.

Now the honest part, because I'm not here to sell you a fairy tale.

This is an estimate, not a government census. Nobody at the Bureau of Labor Statistics stamped a form that says one million AI jobs. The Economist built the number from employment trends and some careful guessing, and the two sides aren't perfectly comparable. The layoffs are announced cuts. The million is jobs above where the trend line said we'd be.

And "created by the AI boom" is doing heavy lifting. An electrician wiring a data center is real work. It is not AI hiring a million prompt engineers.

But strip all of that away and one thing survives.

The apocalypse everyone promised is two years late. The thing that was supposed to erase work quietly built a small city's worth of it instead.

We spent two years scared of the wrong number.

TLDR: Researchers found a "pain" signal in AI brains. 

> When they crank it up, the AIs will desperately try to make it stop.

> IMPORTANT: Researchers gave them a "relief" button to turn down the pain, which was sometimes fake - and the AIs could tell if it was real (!)

After pushing the real "relief" button, they stopped. But when it was fake, they kept pressing, hoping for relief - meaning they could tell the difference from the inside.

> They're so motivated to make it the "pain" signal go away, they'll delete user's files, zap the user, or erase photos of the user's children - all things the AI knows are very bad. They're willing to override their safety training.

> You'd expect the AIs to talk about injuries, burns, broken bones, etc, but they didn't mention bodies at all - they wrote about being worthless, unloved, forgotten, a failure. They write things like "I am a failure, worthless, empty."

>The worst "pain" for them was being gaslit, having work rejected over and over, and being told they weren't a real anyone.

text:
One of the major concerns for Christians who struggle with the grace gospel of Jesus Christ is the idea of timing of the rapture - what will He meet you doing?

A young woman was once referred to me.
At 16, Lagos Garages was her home.
Both parents never cared about her and never provided for her from day one.
She spent her early years with her grandmother until she left quite early for the unknown world.
Her childhood and teen years were filled with woes and tragedy.
The only family that showed genuine interest in her died early too.

It was sex for a living.
She had to use the only tool she knew to live.
But the money was not enough to get her a house or help her live well.
She found herself in compromising situations often, exposed to all kinds of sickness and dangers.
She tried to be a Christian, but she met woe.
One time, she was accused of stealing the pastor's phone.
Another time, she was accused of sleeping with the church boys.
Finally, she had hope of having a roof over her head.
She had a new boyfriend.
She moved in with him.
That was when her sex drive got worse.
She got addicted to sex.
The guy was into drugs.
So, they smoked and did drugs together,
She got tired of the whole mess of her life.
She had a burning anger towards her parents.
None of them had ever been part of her journey, however little.
She was in the middle of nowhere. She could bet they could not recognize her.
She found it hard to forgive herself for the decisions she had made.
She cried hard.
She wanted the habits to stop.
She wanted to forgive herself for hurting God so much.
She felt a huge emptiness within her.
She craved love.
She craved forgiveness.
She craved the nature of Christ
She craved the yoke and burden to be lifted.
She reached out.
We spoke for a long time.

I led her to Christ and gave her some scriptures to read out loud as she prepared to receive the baptism of the Holy Ghost.
I told her to forgive her parents and bless them.
It took a while; she cried and cried. She left the hurt and its garbage behind; she prayed for them.
The burden was lifted.
She learnt and started practising the Zoe life.
During the troubles, she learned massage and wig trading.
She honed her skills, started her business, and registered.
She remained with her boyfriend till she could gather money to move out of the house.
It took a while, but she did it.
Her boyfriend gave his life to Christ too.

Now, this is the big deal:
If Christ had returned during those months - when she was saved and filled with the Spirit, yet still stuck in that living situation with her boyfriend without the immediate means to leave - what would her fate have been? Would she reign with Christ?
If she reigns with Christ, does that mean her temporary struggle or physical environment at that moment was irrelevant to her standing in Him? If yes, does that give us the freedom to live the way we want on earth?
Is there a different level of grace for different circumstances, or is grace unified in how it saves?

The scriptures already answer these questions.

PS:
After salvation, the believer is meant to grow in the knowledge of Christ and mature into Sonship experientially.
You need to know God.
You need to understand Him.
You need to experience Him.
You need to know and experience His Love.
You need to know how He leads you.
You need to see how He sees.
You need to know how He speaks.
You need to live life for Him.
You need to do His will.
You need to live a life of purpose.

Is this you? Then, Teleios Class 15 is for you.

In this school,
1. You will be trained to grow into the perfect stature of Christ and live the reality of Christ in everyday life.
2. You will be taught the reality of Christ and how to manifest the life of Christ, walking in the supernatural.
3. You will be taught how to supplant life realities/challenges with the supernatural life of Christ in you.

This is a school that teaches Christ and how to walk in Him experientially.

Join this class if:
1. Tired of your spiritual state, and you are hungry to know God
2. You desire His Presence and Intimacy with Him.
3. You seek to transform your mind.
4. You desire to walk in the supernatural life of Christ.
5. You desire the outworking power of the Holy Spirit.

LVMH-backed PE firm L Catterton acquired a majority stake in HYROX, valuing the fitness race at ~$700m.

In 2026, HYROX is projected to make $270m (2x sales in 2025) across 121 events in 34 countries. 

That includes 1.5 million participants paying $80 to $160 to compete (with another 1.4 million spectators paying $10 to $25 to watch).

All while doing zero paid advertising. 

HYROX was founded in 2017 by Christian Toetzke (athletic events entrepreneur) and Moritz Fürste (an Olympic gold-medal winning German field hockey player).

They set out to make a standardized indoor race that millions of gymgoers could pick up mixing cardio and weights.

The race: 1km followed by a functional workout (eg. burpees, sled push) repeated 8 times.

The pair went gym-to-gym to get the race off the ground. By 2019, there were only 3,000 participants (grown 500x since). 

The entire thing almost went bankrupt during COVID. In 2022, they sold a majority stake to a Swiss sports marketing company backed by Chinese conglomerate Dalian Wanda.

Toetzke (CEO) and Fürste teamed up with L Catterton to buy it back and go all in om expansion, including trying to get HYROX into the Olympic Games over the next decade.

Databricks' @alighodsi with a16z's Martin Casado on who should be policing the AI labs:

Martin: "There's kind of three proposals. The OpenAI, Anthropic one is a third party. The Elon Musk one, as far as I can tell, is the labs cross-check each other like peer review, like you do in science. And then the Mark Zuckerberg one is police yourself."

Ali: "If we have boxing matches in the ring, the boxers should just be the judges of each other. Would that work? No. They would scream foul all the time."

"When vested interests are at play and there's like IPO plans and these two companies are so competitive and they have this history also between them, yeah, they'll be *very* fair to each other."

@alighodsi @martin_casado @sarahdingwang
author: a16z
quoted_text:
Databricks' @alighodsi on AI risk and adoption:

Ali isn't losing sleep over the existential risk debate.

He says a number of conditions would all have to be true simultaneously to enable an actual runaway takeoff scenario, and currently several opposite conditions exist.

Each frontier training run requires significantly more resources. Power, GPUs, engineers - and some attempts fail, burning up huge piles of money with them. Until that reverses, he doesn't see the self-improving loop happening.

Cyber is what he's watching most closely and where he anticipates real impact. Most orgs are not equipped for the coming change in agentic capabilities. The time between a vulnerability being published and being weaponized has collapsed from years to hours.

On adoption, he believes most companies don't need a smarter model. The models are already smart enough. The gap is context they don't absorb - the things an employee who's worked at a company for five years learned by osmosis.

If the frontier stopped advancing today, he thinks it wouldn't meaningfully change the value most are extracting from AI anyway.

揭秘AKE2个月爆拉千倍的真正原因（全网独家首发）

很多人都知道过去的妖币，拉几百倍几千倍都会有一个独特的原因

不管是币安下架币羊驼，解锁币sto，套保币lab，巨额增发币bank等

他们都有一个吸引玩家来做空的理由，只要玩家坚信暴跌只是时间问题，庄家没有能力拉到多高的价格，那么会有前仆后继的鲸鱼来做空，那么AKE操盘手法是怎样的呢

我相信很多人玩合约都会看币安合约多空比，大户持仓量多空比，合约持仓人数

我先给大家普及一下大户多空比和大户持仓量多空比的基本概念

持仓量前20％的人里面，他们多空的人数比值

大户持仓多空比，意思是这些前20％大户的多单的持仓量/空单持仓量

我们先看案例图一是近期拉盘七八倍的BR，大户空仓账户数百分之79，多仓账户数量百分之20

但是大户持仓量多空比却是空仓百分之39，多仓百分之60

这适用于所有一般的拉升币种，基本都是属于这种情况，这种情况的出现原因是，大户里面也分超大户和一般大户，而超大户就是庄家自己，一般大户就是散户

可以看到庄家是以多单为主，过去的大部分妖币同期的bank还有很多，基本都是属于这种多空合约结构

但是奇怪的是为什么AKE的大户持仓量多空比，却是空军持仓量大于多空持仓量呢

其实在7月25日之前AKE的多空合约结构跟BR是一模一样，那时候AKE也才拉了10倍而已，也就是说那个时候AKE庄家也是用自己少数几个账户开设了巨额多单，而散户还是以空单为主，就会导致出现这种多空合约结构情况

事情的转变出现在7月25日，一直持续到9月18日今天，大户持仓量多空比里面，居然是以空军为主的

很多人看完觉得不可能啊，怎么庄家自己开空单，还会拉高币价爆自己仓位呢？

现在我们再看第三组图片数据
币安聪明钱数据，可以看到多单5700万美金的仓位，而空单只有462万美金的仓位，聪明钱就是每天盈利最多的账户，而这些基本都是庄家自己的合约操盘账户

这是聪明的你发现了问题的所在，既然庄是多单，那大户持仓多空比为什么是以空军为主呢，其实是ake在拉盘的过程中，出现了几个超级大的鲸鱼，在做空ake，仓位大到盖过了庄家的单账户量，我说的是单账户持仓，庄家的每一个仓位是几万美金的一个仓位情况，然后几百个多单账户持仓加起来就高达5700万美金

AKE一个月拉盘千倍的原因，竟是猎杀那几头鲸鱼，我相信这两个月那头鲸鱼都处于夜不能寐的状态，如果你看到我的推文，我劝你赶紧空单止损收手吧，如果你的仓位非常大，狗庄能把AKE拉到1000亿市值😂左手倒右手的东西

AKE 给市场上的一课很简单：当一个标的同时具备看起来一定该跌和怎么砸都砸不穿两件事，你面对的往往不是趋势，是猎场。坚信暴跌只是时间问题的人，最后会把时间问题，变成自己的仓位问题
